accessNotes: sunlightfoundation.com is defunct and web.archive.org was offline; the GitHub repo sunlightlabs/datavizguide no longer exists. The full 13-page PDF guide was downloaded from Amy Cesal's GitHub mirror (amycesal/dataviz-style-guide) and read via pypdf text extraction plus page renders; the original 2014 blog post was read from an archived HTML copy in brianckeegan/sunlight-data-liberation.
summary: A 2014 non-profit/government-transparency web-graphic style: charts sit in a warm off-white (#F5F3F2 / #EFECEA) panel with white gridlines, an ITC Franklin Gothic condensed title with a bold-emphasis word, a Georgia italic explanatory deck, the Sunlight Foundation logo top-right and a Georgia bold/italic source strip at the bottom in a darker band. The palette is earthy (mustard, orange, teal, mauve, taupe) with dedicated political (Republican rust, Democrat blue) and money/pro/con colours.

colors.categoricalNotes: 'Main Colors' in order: a thing #E3BA22, a different thing #E6842A, another different thing #137B80, another different thing #8E6C8A, neutral thing #978F80; No Data #E5E2E0. Each has two 'subset' shades for grouped/stacked sub-categories: light #F2DA57, #F6B656, #42A5B3, #B396AD, #C1BAA9 and dark #BD8F22, #BA5F06, #005D6E, #684664, #7C715E. Network graphs: 30 colours ('TRY not to use them all').
colors.notes: Specialty colours: Republican #9A3E25 (subset #B37055), Democrat RGB 21,107,144 = #156B90 (the PDF misprints its hex as #E6842A; subset #688BAB), Independent #708259 (subset #95A17E), Con #BD2D28 (subset #E25A42), Pro #0F8C79 (subset #6BBBA1), Money #5C8100 (subset #A0B700). Base colours: Background Light #F5F3F2, Background Dark #EFECEA, White line #FFFFFF, Background Dark Accent #E5E2E0, Line Grey Accent #C0C0BB, Text Main #635F5D, Text Light #8E8883; dashed line 'Line Grey 80%' #CDCDC9. Choropleths (≤5 classes + No Data #E5E2E0): Anti→Pro diverging above; money green #0C4E00, #5C8100, #A0B700, #D2CF00, #E6E4A6; 'thing' yellow sequential above; Republican #712422, #9A3E25, #B37055, #D9A78D, #EDCEBC; Democrat #05426C, #E6842A(sic), #688BAB, #8CAEC6, #BAD2E2; R–D diverging #9A3E25, #D9A78D, #C8C6C6, #8CAEC6, #E6842A(sic).

typography.fallback: Georgia (serif companion for deck, callouts and source)

title.weight: Book Condensed with Demi Condensed emphasis word

axisTitle.placement: centred; x title below labels, y title rotated at far left

source.style: Georgia, bold 'Source:' then italic text, left-aligned, vertically centred

typography.notes: Axis labels: ITC Franklin Gothic Std Demi 12px centred on line, #635F5D. Key labels: Franklin Gothic Book 10px left. Point labels: Franklin Gothic Book 10px right-aligned to point (Text Light in line example). Callout text: Georgia italic 10px left #635F5D. Pie labels Franklin Gothic Demi/Book 12px.

structure.gridlines: Solid 1px white (#FFFFFF) gridlines in both directions on the light warm-grey plot background.
structure.axisLine: 1px white axis lines; no dark axis lines.
structure.zeroLine: Bars and lines start at 0 (except scatter plots where the y axis can be altered/broken).
structure.yAxisTitle: rotated, at far left, 22px from labels
structure.unitPlacement: Units on every y tick ('30 units', '$3,000'); bold numbers.
structure.frame: Outer panel #F5F3F2 with 1px light border; title band separated by 1px white rule; source strip in Background Dark #EFECEA below a 1px 4pt-dash/4pt-gap #CDCDC9 rule.
structure.notes: Spacing grid: 22px margins between all blocks (title, plot, axis title, source), 12px top band, 5px label offsets. Width 650px max for regular blog posts, 900px for feature posts; height variable.

legend.placement: right, inside the plot area, in a key box
legend.directLabels: Values can be labelled at key points on lines (Text Light, 10px).
legend.title: not shown
legend.swatchShape: square for bars; short line for line charts
legend.notes: Key box fill Background Dark Accent #E5E2E0 with 1px Line Grey #C0C0BB border; labels Franklin Gothic Book 10px.

marks.bars: Flat fills, no outlines; grouped/stacked bars use the subset shades of each main colour (light shade stacked on darker).
marks.lines: 2px of colour; small dots at labelled points.
marks.points: Scatter: change both colour and shape for groups; possible trend line 1px 4pt-dash 4pt-gap Line Grey.
marks.pies: Use very sparingly, for 2–3 things that add to 100% (include 'other/none'); 1px white stroke between slices; 1px Line Grey leader lines; labels 'Pro (94%)'.
marks.notes: Reference/average line: 1px 4pt dash 4pt gap Line Grey.

labels.dataLabels: Selective point labels at key points; value labels in Text Light 10px.
labels.numberFormat: Thousands comma, currency prefix ($3,030); percentages in parentheses in pie labels.

furniture.title: Title in Franklin Gothic condensed with one emphasised (Demi) word, e.g. 'Title of the **chart**', followed by a short Georgia italic explanatory line.
furniture.source: Required source strip at bottom: 'Source:' in Georgia bold followed by italic URL/text, 8px, #8E8883, in a darker #EFECEA band.
furniture.logo: Sunlight Foundation logo top-right, 100px wide, 22px from right edge, aligned opposite the title.
furniture.other: Callout boxes: white fill, 1px Line Grey #C0C0BB border with pointer, Georgia italic 10px text.

annotations: Speech-bubble callouts with white fill and 1px #C0C0BB border pointing to bars; Georgia italic 10px #635F5D; dashed reference line labelled with a callout box.
layout: 650px max width (blog), 900px (feature); variable height; 22px spacing system; 12px top band; logo 100px wide.
interaction: The blog mentions tooltip guidance but the PDF shows none.
accessibility: Scatter groups should change colour and shape ('helps with sight issues'); choropleths ≤5 classes.

chartTypes.notes: Each type page gives 'When to use' bullets and 'Your data should look like' table.

referenceImages.describes: 'Basic Structure' spec: warm light-grey panel with thin outer border. Title band: 'Title of the **chart**' in grey condensed Franklin Gothic with bold last word, Georgia italic deck beneath; yellow-circle SUNLIGHT FOUNDATION logo top-right; band separated by a 1px white rule. Plot: white horizontal and vertical gridlines, bold grey y labels '30 units/20 units/10 units/0', rotated 'Y Axis Title', bold category labels below, centred 'X Axis Title'. Bottom: dashed grey rule then slightly darker strip with 'Source: www.fruitsperbushel.com' in tiny Georgia bold+italic. Pink annotations give 22px spacings, 650px/900px widths and colours.

Grouped stacked column chart Monday–Friday: mustard (apples) and orange (oranges) columns, each stacked with a lighter subset shade on top. White gridlines on #F5F3F2; dashed grey horizontal reference line with a white bordered callout box in Georgia italic; two speech-bubble callouts pointing at bars; legend key box at right with square swatches on #E5E2E0 fill and grey border; source strip at bottom; logo top-right.

Political line graph: 2px rust Republican line and steel-blue Democrat line with small dots and grey value labels ($3,030, $2,100, $1,090, $590, $710, $930) at decade points. White gridlines, bold '$3,000 … 0' y labels and bold years 2000/2010/2020; legend key box upper right with short line swatches; rotated y title; source strip; logo top-right.
